n13868b0bb56.s: In Andhra Pradesh's industrial map, leather and auto parts are associated with which district?
n13868b0bb56.x: Leather and auto parts are associated with Nellore; Prakasam is associated with mineral-based industries.

n8019936e189.s: How many use-based classes are employed in the Index of Industrial Production?
n8019936e189.x: The IIP uses six use-based classes: primary, capital, intermediate, infrastructure/construction, consumer durables and consumer non-durables. There is no export goods class.

nf3cf61565c8.s:
Consider the following statements about Geographical Indication tags in Andhra Pradesh:
1. Dharmavaram and Mangalagiri products carry GI tags.
2. Kondapalli products carry a GI tag.
3. Chirala products carry a GI tag.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
nf3cf61565c8.x: Dharmavaram, Mangalagiri, Kondapalli and Etikoppaka products carry GI tags. Chirala is not in that group, so statement 3 is wrong.

n15022bb567c.s: Which of India's four PCPIRs is located in Andhra Pradesh?
n15022bb567c.x: The four PCPIRs are Visakhapatnam-Kakinada, Dahej, Paradip and Cuddalore-Nagapattinam; Visakhapatnam-Kakinada is the Andhra Pradesh one. (Sequence not possible: no dates given.)

n35b0d1aa56e.s: In which year was the South Central Railway zone formed?
n35b0d1aa56e.x: South Central Railway was formed in 1966; East Central came in 2002 and Metro Railway in 2010.

n1e7a14e4c48.s: The North-South and East-West corridors have their junction at:
n1e7a14e4c48.x: The two corridors meet at Jhansi, not Nagpur.

n4dd31b17769.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about PM Gati Shakti?
o: It has a three-tier structure of EGoS, Network Planning Group and Technical Support Unit
Its apex Empowered Group of Secretaries is headed by the Minister of Road Transport and Highways
Its apex Empowered Group of Secretaries is under the Cabinet Secretary
The Network Planning Group is one of its tiers
n4dd31b17769.x: The apex EGoS is under the Cabinet Secretary, not a minister.

n703bea080a8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about freight transport modes?
o: Air transport is the fastest mode
Air transport is the costliest per tonne-km
Road transport is the cheapest of all surface modes
n703bea080a8.x: Road is the costliest surface mode, though it offers door-to-door reach; air is the fastest and costliest per tonne-km.

new.s: In the Index of Core Industries rebased to 2022-23, which industry carries the highest weight?
new.x: Electricity has the heaviest weight (30.93), ahead of refinery products (22.57) and steel (17.58).

new.s: After rebasing to 2022-23, how many industries does the Index of Core Industries cover?
new.x: With iron ore added, the index now covers 9 industries, not 8.

new.s: Which industry was newly added to the Index of Core Industries in its 2022-23 base?
new.x: Iron ore is the newest member, taking the index from 8 to 9 industries.

new.s: From 1 April 2025, a micro enterprise has an investment limit of up to:
new.x: Micro: investment up to ₹2.5 crore and turnover up to ₹10 crore.

new.s: From 1 April 2025, the turnover ceiling for a medium enterprise is:
new.x: Medium: investment up to ₹125 crore and turnover up to ₹500 crore; ₹100 crore is the small-enterprise turnover limit.

new.s: Diamond polishing and software are examples of which type of industry?
new.x: Footloose industries need skilled labour and internet, not a particular raw material.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about heavy and light industries:
1. Heavy industries are bulky and capital-intensive, such as HEC Ranchi.
2. Electronics assembly and garments are light industries.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Heavy industries such as iron and steel and HEC Ranchi are bulky and capital-intensive; light industries such as electronics assembly and garments use lighter inputs.

new.s: Amul of Anand is an example of which sector of industry?
new.x: Amul is a cooperative; Maruti Udyog was originally a joint-sector unit.

new.s: Which of the following pairs of industry and ownership sector is correctly matched?
new.x: NALCO is a public-sector unit. BHEL is public, JSW private and Maharashtra sugar mills cooperative.

new.s: Under the Industrial Policy Resolution 1956, Schedule A industries such as arms and atomic energy were reserved for the:
new.x: Schedule A (arms, atomic energy, iron and steel) was for the public sector; Schedule B was open to both.

new.s: Thermal power accounts for about what share of industrial water use in India?
new.x: Thermal power is the largest industrial water user at about 88%; engineering uses about 5%.

new.s: Coastal aquaculture processing is classified as which type of industry?
new.x: Industries based on sea produce, such as seafood and coastal aquaculture processing, are marine-based.

new.s: The largest forest-based industry is:
new.x: Pulp and paper is the largest forest-based industry.

new.s: Rayon, or artificial silk, is based on:
new.x: Rayon is made from wood pulp, so it is a forest-based industry.

new.s: Which countries are the top exporters of paper?
new.x: Finland, Sweden and Canada are the top paper exporters; China, India and Indonesia lead in rayon.

new.s: Which country is the largest exporter of furniture?
new.x: China is the largest furniture exporter.

new.s: In paper making, recycled fibre makes up about what share of the raw material?
new.x: Recycled fibre is 71-75% of the raw material; wood pulp is about 21%.

new.s: Under BRAP 2020, released in June 2022, Andhra Pradesh was placed among the:
new.x: In BRAP 2020 Andhra Pradesh was among the 7 top achievers; States were grouped into categories.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about BRAP 2020:
1. It was released in June 2022.
2. It ranked States in numerical order from first to last.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: BRAP 2020 was released in June 2022 and grouped States into categories, not ranks.

new.s: The CII Partnership Summit of 14-15 November 2025 was held at:
new.x: The CII Partnership Summit was held at Visakhapatnam on 14-15 November 2025.

new.s: Udyam registration of MSMEs began on:
new.x: Udyam registration has run since 1 July 2020.

new.s: By 15 December 2025, Andhra Pradesh had about how many Udyam-registered MSMEs?
new.x: Andhra Pradesh had 36,80,310 Udyam-registered MSMEs by 15 December 2025.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Udyam-registered MSMEs in Andhra Pradesh as of 15 December 2025:
1. Anantapur had more registered MSMEs than Prakasam.
2. The State total was more than 36 lakh.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Anantapur had 2,37,332 against Prakasam's 1,93,178, and the State total was 36,80,310.

new.s: The AP Cluster Development Programme (G.O. 17, January 2026) gives aid of up to what share?
new.x: The programme covers 45 MSME clusters/CFCs with ₹200 crore and aid of up to 80%.

new.s: How many MSME clusters/CFCs are covered by the AP Cluster Development Programme of 2026?
new.x: The programme covers 45 MSME clusters/common facility centres with ₹200 crore.

new.s: Which policy was notified through G.O. 69 on 26 October 2024?
new.x: G.O. 68 notified the Industrial Development Policy and G.O. 69 the MSME policy.

new.s: AP Industrial Development Policy 4.0 targets an investment of:
new.x: The policy targets ₹30 lakh crore of investment and 5 lakh jobs.

new.s: AP Industrial Development Policy 4.0 (2024-29) replaced which policy?
new.x: Policy 4.0 replaced the Industrial Development Policy 2023-27.

new.s: The RINL-Visakhapatnam Steel Plant was built with technology from:
new.x: RINL-VSP, India's first shore-based integrated steel plant, uses USSR technology.

new.s: BHPV at Visakhapatnam was established in:
new.x: BHPV dates from 1966; Hindustan Shipyard is 1941, HPCL refinery 1957 and RINL 1992.

new.s: The gas-based fertiliser units of Andhra Pradesh, using KG-basin gas, are located at:
new.x: Gas-based fertiliser units are at Kakinada, using KG-basin gas.

new.s: The JSW integrated steel plant in Andhra Pradesh is located in which district?
new.x: The JSW integrated steel plant is in YSR Kadapa; the AM/NS steel plant is in Anakapalli.

new.s: APGIC, which works on KG-basin gas, is a joint venture of:
new.x: APGIC is an APIIC-APGENCO joint venture on KG gas.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the traditional silk industry of Andhra Pradesh:
1. Silk was a luxury good.
2. The industry was mainly rural.
3. The weavers were mainly Devanga and Padmasali.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Silk was a luxury good woven mainly by Devanga and Padmasali weavers; the industry was not mainly rural.

new.s: Peddapuram, a historic silk centre, is in which district?
new.x: Peddapuram is in Kakinada district; Chirala is in Bapatla and Dharmavaram in Sri Sathya Sai.

new.s: JN Pharma City at Parawada is in which district?
new.x: JN Pharma City is at Parawada in Anakapalli district.

new.s: The Tekulodu Aerospace and Defence Park, proposed under BHAVYA, is in which district?
new.x: Tekulodu is in Sri Sathya Sai; Drone City is in Kurnool and Space City in Tirupati.

new.s: How many VCIC nodes does Andhra Pradesh have, spread over about 33,000 acres?
new.x: VCIC has 3 nodes in AP - Visakhapatnam, Chittoor and Kopparthy - over 33,000 acres.

new.s: The PCPIR of Andhra Pradesh, approved in 2009, covers about:
new.x: The Visakhapatnam-Kakinada PCPIR, approved in 2009, covers about 640 sq km.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor?
o: It is India's first coastal corridor
It is the first phase of the East Coast Economic Corridor
Its northern region focuses on metallurgy, pharma and petrochemicals
It is partly funded by a JICA loan
new.x: VCIC is partly funded by an ADB loan, not JICA.

new.s: Which State has the highest road density in India?
new.x: Kerala has the highest road density, followed by Tripura.

new.s: NH-966B, India's shortest National Highway (8 km), is located at:
new.x: NH-966B runs from Kundannoor to Willingdon Island in Kochi.

new.s: NH-44, India's longest National Highway, crosses how many States?
new.x: NH-44 (Srinagar-Kanyakumari, about 4,112 km) crosses 11 States.

new.s: Which of the following cities is NOT on the Golden Quadrilateral?
new.x: The Golden Quadrilateral links Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata; Hyderabad is not on it.

new.s: Which State has the longest stretch of the Golden Quadrilateral?
new.x: Andhra Pradesh has the longest GQ stretch (1,014 km); Maharashtra has the longest total NH length.

new.s: Bharatmala Pariyojana (2017) envisages about how many km of corridors?
new.x: Bharatmala plans about 34,800 km of corridors to 580+ districts; 22,590 km had been built by 2026.

new.s: The Wheel and Axle Plant of Indian Railways is located at:
new.x: The Wheel and Axle Plant (1984) is at Bengaluru.

new.s: The Integral Coach Factory at Perambur was set up in 1955 in collaboration with:
new.x: ICF Perambur was set up in 1955 with Swiss collaboration.

new.s: Which of the following UNESCO hill railway – State pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Kalka-Shimla is in Himachal Pradesh; Darjeeling Himalayan is in West Bengal and Nilgiri Mountain in Tamil Nadu.

new.s: After the creation of South Coast Railway, how many zones does Indian Railways have?
new.x: There are 18 zones; counting 19 wrongly includes Konkan Railway, which is a PSU.

new.s: The headquarters of East Coast Railway is at:
new.x: East Coast Railway (2003) is headquartered at Bhubaneswar; Hajipur is East Central's HQ.

new.s: Which was the first fully electrified State of India?
new.x: Haryana was the first fully electrified State and also has the first hydrogen train.

new.s: The Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor (Ludhiana-Sonnagar) is funded by:
new.x: The Eastern DFC is World Bank-funded; the Western DFC is funded by JICA.

new.s: The first Vande Bharat Sleeper train (2026) runs between:
new.x: The first Vande Bharat Sleeper runs Guwahati-Kolkata; the first Vande Bharat (2019) ran New Delhi-Varanasi.

new.s: The Dhola-Sadiya (Bhupen Hazarika Setu) bridge spans which river?
new.x: Dhola-Sadiya is on the Lohit river, linking Assam and Arunachal Pradesh.

new.s: India's first cable-stayed rail bridge is:
new.x: Anji Khad on the USBRL is India's first cable-stayed rail bridge; Chenab is the highest arch rail bridge.

new.s: Which is India's longest rail tunnel, on the USBRL?
new.x: T-50 on the USBRL is India's longest rail tunnel.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the USBRL:
1. It has 36 tunnels and 943 bridges.
2. Anji Khad is the world's highest railway arch bridge.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: USBRL has 36 tunnels and 943 bridges. The world's highest railway arch bridge is the Chenab Bridge, not Anji Khad.

new.s: The HBJ (HVJ) gas pipeline is about how long?
new.x: The GAIL-built HBJ gas pipeline is about 1,750 km long.

new.s: The PM Urja Ganga gas pipeline is built by:
new.x: PM Urja Ganga is a GAIL project, the first link of east and north-east India to the gas grid.

new.s: The Kandla-Bathinda crude pipeline links Gujarat with:
new.x: Kandla-Bathinda runs from Gujarat to Punjab.

new.s: The Inland Waterways Authority of India (1986) is headquartered at:
new.x: IWAI was set up in 1986 with its headquarters at Noida.

new.s: India's first official airmail flight (18 February 1911) flew between:
new.x: The first official airmail flight flew from Allahabad to Naini, piloted by Henri Pequet.

new.s: Which was the first carbon-neutral airport in the Asia-Pacific?
new.x: Delhi became the first carbon-neutral airport in the Asia-Pacific in September 2016; Hyderabad followed in December 2016.

new.s: RCS-UDAN was launched under which policy?
new.x: RCS-UDAN comes under the National Civil Aviation Policy 2016 and uses viability gap funding.

new.s: PM Gati Shakti brought how many ministries onto one platform?
new.x: PM Gati Shakti brought 16 ministries, such as Railways, Roads, Ports and Aviation, onto one platform.

new.s: Which mode is the cheapest for transporting oil and gas?
new.x: Pipelines are the cheapest for oil and gas; inland waterways are the cheapest general freight mode.
